questiontext.text:
Explain why the values of an increasing exponetial will eventually overtake the values of an increasing linear function.

[[input:ans1]] [[validation:ans1]][[feedback:prt1]]

generalfeedback.text:
Worked solution

Linear functions have a constant rate of change. Exponential functions increase based on a percent of the original.
